units.source_text: 雨停止了。

en.t: The rain stopped.

units.source_text: 微风敲竹，清音悦耳；

en.t: A light breeze tapped the bamboo, making a clear and pleasing sound;

units.source_text: 云破月来，银光皎洁。

en.t: the clouds parted and the moon appeared, its silver light bright and pure.

units.source_text: 似这般好天良夜，真有无限清幽之趣。

en.t: On such a fine and beautiful night, there was truly endless quiet charm.

units.source_text: 众侍女看见两人促膝谈心，有所顾忌，都回避了。

en.t: Seeing the two of them sitting close together in private conversation, the ladies-in-waiting felt some restraint and all withdrew.

units.source_text: 两人原是常常见面的，然而像今夜这种机会，也很难得。

en.t: The two of them did often see each other, but an opportunity like tonight was still very rare.

units.source_text: 大约是言语一经出口，热情便不可遏之故，

en.t: Perhaps it was because once the words had been spoken, his passion could no longer be restrained,

units.source_text: 此时源氏就用巧妙的手腕，把穿惯的那件上衣悄悄地脱去，横卧在玉鬘身旁了。

en.t: for at this point Genji used a clever stratagem, quietly slipped off the robe he usually wore, and lay down beside Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 玉鬘心甚厌恶，生怕被侍女们看见了，成个什么样子，便觉异常痛苦。

en.t: Tamakazura felt deep revulsion, and the fear of being seen by the ladies-in-waiting and of what it would look like caused her extraordinary anguish.

units.source_text: 她想：如果在真的父亲身边，即使他对我漠不关心，总不会遭此蹂躏。

en.t: She thought: If I were beside my real father, even if he were indifferent to me, I would never suffer this violation.

units.source_text: 因此十分悲伤。

en.t: Because of this, she was deeply sorrowful.

units.source_text: 虽然竭力忍耐，终于两泪夺眶而出，那模样真是可怜。

en.t: Though she tried her utmost to endure it, tears finally burst from both her eyes, and her appearance was truly pitiful.

units.source_text: 源氏便对她说：“你这样讨厌我，真使我伤心啊！

en.t: Genji then said to her, "It truly grieves me that you dislike me so much!

units.source_text: 离居两地、素不相识之人，一经相爱，都容许如此，这是世间常规。

en.t: Even people who live apart and have never known each other are allowed this once they fall in love; that is the way of the world.

units.source_text: 何况我和你长年和睦相处，如此亲近一下，有何不可呢？

en.t: How much more, then, when you and I have lived in harmony for years; what harm is there in a little closeness like this?

units.source_text: 我决不会有越此限度的野心，只是聊以慰藉难于忍受的万种相思而已。”

en.t: I will never have any desire to go beyond this limit; I only wish to comfort, a little, the countless unbearable longings of love."

units.source_text: 又说了许多亲爱甜蜜的话。

en.t: He also spoke many affectionate and sweet words.

units.source_text: 加之这个睡在身边的人，模样竟与故人完全肖似，真使他不胜感慨。

en.t: Moreover, the person sleeping beside him looked exactly like the one he had lost, and this filled him with overwhelming emotion.

units.source_text: 源氏虽然有心为此，但也知道此乃唐突轻佻之行，因此立刻回心转意。

en.t: Although Genji had intended to do this, he also knew it was an abrupt and frivolous act, and so he immediately changed his mind.

units.source_text: 深恐侍女们诧怪，夜色未深之时就起身辞去。

en.t: Greatly afraid that the ladies-in-waiting would find it strange, he rose and took his leave before the night had grown late.

units.source_text: 临别对玉鬘说：“你倘为此而厌恶我，真使我伤心极了。

en.t: As he parted, he said to Tamakazura, "If you dislike me because of this, it will grieve me beyond measure.

units.source_text: 别人决不会如此热情地爱你。

en.t: No one else would ever love you with such passion.

units.source_text: 我对你的爱不可限量，无有底止，所以我决不做惹人讥评之事。

en.t: My love for you is immeasurable and bottomless, and so I will never do anything that invites criticism.

units.source_text: 我只是为了要慰藉对故人的恋慕之情，今后亦将对你说些风流绮语。

en.t: I only wish to soothe my longing for the one who is gone, and in the future I will still speak to you in graceful words of love.

units.source_text: 但愿你体谅我心，好好地回答我。”

en.t: I hope you will understand my heart and answer me properly."

units.source_text: 这番话说得非常周至。

en.t: These words were spoken with great care and consideration.

units.source_text: 然而玉鬘此时已经懊恼得不知死活，听了他的话越发愁苦了。

en.t: Yet by then Tamakazura was already so distressed that she scarcely knew whether she was alive or dead, and hearing his words made her still more miserable.

units.source_text: 源氏又说：“我以为你不是十分无情的，想不到你如此讨厌我。”

en.t: Genji said again, "I thought you were not entirely heartless; I never imagined you would dislike me so much."

units.source_text: 他叹息一声，继续说道：“今天的事情，切不可教外人知道啊！”

en.t: He sighed once and continued, "You must absolutely not let outsiders know about what happened today!"

units.source_text: 说过就回去了。

en.t: After saying this, he went back.

units.source_text: 玉鬘虽然已届青春年华，但对男女之事毫无经验。

en.t: Although Tamakazura had already reached the age of young womanhood, she had no experience at all in matters between men and women.

units.source_text: 连略知此道的人，她也少有接近。

en.t: She had seldom even been near people who knew a little about such matters.

units.source_text: 她不知道男女之间还有比共卧更甚的亲昵关系。

en.t: She did not know that between men and women there could be intimacies beyond lying together.

units.source_text: 因此伤心悲叹，以为今天遭逢了意外的不幸，脸上神色异常惨恶。

en.t: Therefore she grieved and lamented, thinking she had met with an unexpected misfortune that day, and her face looked unusually wretched.

units.source_text: 众侍女看见了，纷纷谈论：“小姐今天身体不好呢！”

en.t: When the ladies-in-waiting saw her, they all began saying, "The young lady is unwell today!"

units.source_text: 大家前来伺候。

en.t: Everyone came forward to attend to her.

units.source_text: 侍女兵部君等悄悄地议论道：“源氏主君对小姐关怀周至，真教人感激不尽啊！

en.t: The lady-in-waiting Hyobukyo and the others quietly discussed it, saying, "Lord Genji shows such thorough concern for the young lady; we truly cannot be grateful enough!

units.source_text: 即使是真的父亲，也不会如此无微不至地照顾她吧。”

en.t: Even a real father would probably not care for her with such minute attention."

units.source_text: 玉鬘听了这话，更加讨厌源氏了，她想不到他怀着这不良之心。

en.t: When Tamakazura heard these words, she disliked Genji even more, for she had never imagined he harbored such improper intentions.

units.source_text: 又慨叹自己的身世，不胜悲伤。

en.t: She also lamented her own fate and was overcome with sorrow.
